name: lessentiel
description: O essencial da sua leitura. Extensão local para páginas web e PDFs, sem distrações.
author: BrunodosSantosVaz

scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build && playwright install chromium && playwright test && npm run test:regression
scripts.format: oxfmt .oxlintrc.json .bigbang-docs.json package.json package-lock.json "*.ts" "*.mjs" scripts tests src entrypoints --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check .oxlintrc.json .bigbang-docs.json package.json package-lock.json "*.ts" "*.mjs" scripts tests src entrypoints --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
